visual_review: Before had a flat rim line with the chopsticks as short floating strokes hooking into the rim (read as steam or a 'W'); redrawn like the reference: a deep round bowl with an elliptical open rim (back edge higher, front edge sagging) and two long chopsticks dipping behind the front rim and leaning up to the right, the back rim breaking between them.
